text:
Nora Patel: Heads-up — Hosted Streaming Toolcalls v1.1 is going GA today. Main changes: partial-response streaming (chunks with tool-metadata), tool prefetch hints, and a new console toggle (Console → Toolcalls → Streaming). Rolling out region-by-region over ~2.5h. :rocket:
Eric Zhang: great! timeline and any client work required?
Nora Patel: rollout starts 18:00 PT for US regions, then EU/APAC. No mandatory breaking changes but we recommend bumping SDKs to v2.3.0 to handle "prefetch" events and the new chunk envelope. Older SDKs still work but won't surface prefetch hints.
Samira Khan: runtime impact / perf concerns? ops watching?
eng-sre-bot: runbook added: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/streaming-toolcalls-ga. Key alerts: if stream chunk error-rate > 1% sustained 5m or p95 token-latency increases by +35% for 10m, escalate. Canary keys: stream-canary-01..06. Auto-rollback policy in play.
Nora Patel: billing note: basic streaming is same price, but prefetch bundles (optional) incur a small per-bundle charge labeled "stream-prefetch". Customers will see a billing opt-in in Console and must enable prefetch in their account settings to be charged.
Eric Zhang: Dedicated / Private customers?
Nora Patel: Dedicated: admin toggle Admin → Feature Flags → StreamingToolcalls. Private: available in the 1.9.0 on-prem bundle; operators must run the migration script (link in docs).
docs-bot: docs live: https://docs.redwood.ai/streaming-toolcalls-v1-1 (includes migration notes, curl + js examples, and sample chunk envelopes)
Samira Khan: marketing / comms plan?
marketing-bot: Product + Marketing will post a public changelog, send targeted emails to accounts using toolcalls, and publish a short demo video. Please tag #marketing for customer stories.
Nora Patel: quick curl example (prefetch enabled):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/toolcall/stream \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Stream-Mode: prefetch" \
  -d '{"tool":"facts","input":"latest stats"}'
```
Nora Patel: js SDK snippet (v2.3.0+):
```js
const client = new Redwood.Client({ key: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
const stream = client.toolcall.stream({ tool: 'facts', mode: 'prefetch' });
stream.on('chunk', (ch) => {
  // ch.type = 'prefetch' | 'partial' | 'final'
  // ch.meta contains tool timing
  console.log(ch);
});
```
Eric Zhang: deprecation note?
Nora Patel: we will deprecate the legacy query param `stream_mode=legacy` on 2026-10-01. Migration guide in docs.
Samira Khan: QA / rollout ops: who to ping for regressions?
eng-sre-bot: @eng-sre oncall. If you hit regressions, tag the canary key in alerts and open the runbook incident link.
Nora Patel: final: short AMA at 19:00 PT in #product for questions. Thanks all — please retag if you need early access or want to test in canary. :white_check_mark:
